findings.finding: The first loader only checked hash entries present in reader-comparison. Missing bindings could silently remove review protection and allow arbitrary TeX to be displayed under a legitimate source excerpt.
findings.resolution: Root now requires the exact mandatory seven-path binding set, plus correct comparison schema, before hash validation. Both omission/injection regressions reject on source LF hash 361b828c9f0fb37d024c53b92cfdd3cc0ed039dea53eb65f87dda94ed1e86591.
findings.evidence: integration-binding-negative-checks.json (historical failing cases); integration-binding-regression-checks.json (bound fixed cases). The initial failing artifact lacks an exact contemporaneous source hash and must not be misrepresented as a final-code result.

findings.resolution: Root is authorized to commit/push/merge/deploy and will publish a committed candidate containing all cited paths. The new check_publication_sources rejects absent or byte-different publication blobs and is wired into main publish. No replacement with unpinned URLs is recommended.

findings.finding: New phase/review/notation receipts include CRLF and carry exact raw hashes; the previous broad Git LF rule would invalidate seals on commit/checkout.
findings.resolution: Narrow report-only -text -eol exception verified after broad benchmark rule. All 147 staged audit-receipt/contributed-manifest-inventory byte comparisons equal their worktree originals; no normalization or resealing. cr-at-eol whitespace handling permits preserved CRLF. One exact original failed-run transcript has an exact-file -whitespace exemption; it does not alter bytes or broaden validation claims. Final commit/CI checkout is root-owned.

limitations: Static HTML checks validate paths, initial markup and selected answer-string confinement, not screen-reader behavior, visual disclosure state, responsive layout, interaction timing, search indexing of the final full-site artifact or MathJax success.

Manual code review plus omission regressions do not prove reviewer independence in the world or semantic equivalence of arbitrary notation. Exact comparison records and actual mathematical reviews remain separate evidence.
Main loader and publisher have current-file bindings only as recorded above; any later edits require revalidation.
